text:
maria: Quick heads up — PR #18899 (hotfix: session-ttl) needs to land before today's deploy freeze at 22:00 UTC. CI is slow. Anyone able to review/approve?

ajay: Pinged. What's the blocker in CI? flaky tests?

maria: Integration suite: auth-integration failing intermittently. Runs are queued: https://ci.example.com/build/8273

ci-bot: build/8271 failed: auth-integration — flaky timeout on step 'token-refresh' (re-run recommended)

leo: I can take a look in ~15m. Do we need a rebase? Branch is 4 commits behind main.

tia: If we rebase now we risk new CI runs and miss freeze. Alternative: can we cherry-pick the hotfix commit onto a fresh branch off main and open a tiny PR to avoid the larger rebase?

ajay: +1 to cherry-pick. That avoids merge conflicts and keeps change minimal.

maria: Good plan. I can cut cherry-pick branch. Question: is canary allowed during freeze window? release-bot?

release-bot: Canary deployments paused during deploy-freeze window (2026-03-18 22:00 UTC -> 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC). Emergency exceptions require release lead approval.

leo: Okay, still safe to land before 22:00 if CI clears. If not, we'll hold and coordinate emergency patch in the morning.

tia: For quick eyes: @leo can you skim tests related to auth-integration? Might be flaky due to timeouts, not actual failure.

leo: Will do. If it's flaky, I'll re-run the failing job and approve if green. If it fails consistently, we'll revert to manual patch.

ajay: If you need me to merge after approval, I'm available to press the merge button and monitor.

maria: Cutting cherry-pick branch now and pushing. Will post link when open.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/PR/18901 — contains cherry-picked hotfix only.

ci-bot: PR 18901 build queued: 8274

leo: Ran quick local test for token-refresh, passes locally. Rerunning job now.

ci-bot: build/8274 succeeded ✅

leo: LGTM. small nit in comment, not blocking. Approving.

tia: Approved from me as well. :thumbsup: 

ajay: Merging now. I'll hold a monitor run for 10m post deploy.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: PR 18901 -> production (immediate) by ajay

ajay: Deployed and smoke checks ok. No error spikes in the last 10m.

maria: Thanks all 🙏 Saved the freeze.
